title: relaxfree-defect-audit: when can defect relaxation be skipped? A cross-host audit of relaxation-free point-defect prescreening
description: Code, processed data, result tables and figures for a decision-level audit of relaxation-free point-defect prescreening. Matched ideal-site and relaxed formation energies of 813 neutral defects in 32 group IV, III-V and II-VI zinc blende hosts are used to measure how many low-energy defects a screen loses when relaxation is skipped, by host family and defect class; to calibrate split-conformal margins that control this miss rate, with abstention where a cell cannot be calibrated; and to test transfer to unseen hosts and chemical families. An external check uses HSE06 relaxations of cation vacancies in chalcogenide hosts. All tables and figures are generated by the scripts in the repository.
